newsitem.title: USA: Sunstone CFO comfortable FFO estimates.
newsitem.headline: Sunstone CFO comfortable FFO estimates.

text.p: Sunstone Hotel Investors Inc chief financial officer, Kenneth Biehl, said the company was comfortable with analysts' projections of 12.5 percent growth in per share funds from operations in 1997.
"We're comfortable with analysts' projections for FFO per share growth," he told Reuters after a presentation at the Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference.
Biehl said the company had 12.5 percent per share FFO growth in 1996 and analysts were projecting the same rate for 1997.
The company, which went public in 1995, reported FFO per share of $1.19 in 1996 versus a pro forma $1.05 in 1995.
